title: Conjugation condition for a normalized quotient section tensor comparison
statement: For every normalized quotient section tensor comparison barB, its SectionTensorNormalized equations imply TensorSectionCondition for the supplied normalized internal tensorator b.

proof.text: Prove the displayed conjugation equation after choosing flat-term K-flat representatives for both derived inputs; expand the normalized section tensor equation and cancel the scalar and tensor comparison maps.
The representative equation is extended from flat-term K-flat representatives to all derived pairs by the resolving-class uniqueness theorem for derived tensor natural transformations.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06YY, 07A4 and 07A6; decomposed into representative conjugation and resolving-class extension.
